title: Choose who answers incoming calls
blurb: Ring your mobile, ring the team, or record calls.

steps.title: Open Settings
steps.body: Click **Settings** at the bottom of the left menu.

steps.title: Open Phone System
steps.body: Click **Phone System** in the Settings menu.

steps.title: Open your numbers
steps.tip: See **Your phone system requires configuration**? We need to switch Luubu Phone on for you. Email hello@luubu.com.

steps.title: Edit the number
steps.body: Click the three dots next to the number, then **Edit Configuration**.

steps.title: Name it
steps.body: Give the number a friendly name like "Main line" so the team knows which one rang.

steps.title: Who it rings
steps.body: Choose where calls go: your mobile, one team member, or several team members at once.

steps.title: Ring time
steps.body: Set **Incoming Call Timeout** to about 20 seconds. Longer and calls may drop into your mobile carrier's voicemail instead of Luubu's.

steps.title: Recording (optional)
steps.body: Turn on **Call Recording** if you want recordings. Play a short "this call may be recorded" message too.

steps.title: Save
steps.body: Save, then ring the number from another phone to test.
